problem: Portal V2 canvas/model projections could visually resemble customer answers; CI also exposed stale semantic/DOM oracles and invalid delivery metadata.
rootCauses: Canvas presentation mixed derived Powerhouse projections with customer-entered values.
Semantic and production DOM tests encoded the former mixed-provenance wording/expectations.
PR delivery metadata used candidate types outside the canonical hygiene allow-list and omitted Base-SHA.
Auto-merge could promote a PR before its visual PR-readback finished; the push readback then raced the PR artifact and the PR base production SHA could disappear before capture completed.
rules: Customer truth and derived Powerhouse evidence are separate provenance classes.
Missing customer input remains visibly and persistently missing; derived signals never backfill customer answers.
Use truth states answered, not_answered, not_asked, not_applicable, derived, insufficient_evidence.
All portal business input remains tenant-scoped in the existing canonical Powerhouse persistence path; no parallel store.
Tests/readbacks must assert provenance semantics, not merely non-empty rendering.
Validate Delivery-Lane, Candidate-Type and Base-SHA against canonical delivery-hygiene policy before expensive CI.
Never assign LIVE & BEWEZEN until exact-head gates, protected merge, main SHA and production readback are proven.
PR visual evidence must be captured from the exact immutable candidate deploy; it must not depend on the mutable production alias still exposing the PR base SHA.
Post-merge production readback must bounded-wait for the successful exact-head PR readback artifact instead of failing immediately on an artifact race.
Auto-merge must never create a terminal false-negative readback solely because evidence production and evidence consumption raced.

productionReadback.publicRoutes: 91 routes x 3 viewports = 273 browser checks green

finalClosure.definitionOfDone: exact-head gates -> protected merge -> main SHA -> production DOM/readback -> visual regression -> evidence -> learning/prevention writeback
prevention: Treat workflow-not-started, queued, stale, race and missing-readback states as recoverable incomplete execution.
Capture exact-head immutable evidence before consuming it after auto-merge.
Do not claim LIVE_AND_PROVEN until production readback is terminal green.
